patch_description:
This constructor uses a compact portfolio of square-interstice and staggered hexagonal/layered seeds, followed by joint nonlinear optimization of centers and unequal radii. It supplies analytic Jacobians for all wall and pair-clearance constraints using true Euclidean distances, which gives SLSQP better scaling than squared-distance constraints near the final contact graph.

Each optimized center arrangement is then certified and improved with an exact fixed-center linear program for the radii. The returned radii receive a final common safety contraction, preserving the optimized unequal-radius pattern while guaranteeing all circles stay inside the square and remain non-overlapping despite floating-point tolerances.
